newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBM launches 50 bln yen 5.3% yen/US$ samurai - Daiwa.
newsitem.headline: IBM launches 50 bln yen 5.3% yen/US$ samurai - Daiwa.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp (IBM) on Wednesday launched 50 billion yen worth of 5.3 percent yen/U.S. dollar dual currency samurai bonds due September 1999, lead manager Daiwa Securities Co Ltd said.
The bonds were priced at par.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows. AMT 50 bln yen COUPON 5.3 pct MATURITY Sep 30, 1999 TYPE dual-currency samurai PAY DATE Sep 30, 1996
ISS PRICE par SUB PERIOD Sep 11 - Sep 27
INTEREST PAYMENT Sep 30 SIGN DATE Sep 10, 1996

LAST RATING A1(Moody's), A(S&P) LEAD MANAGER Daiwa Securities Co Ltd LEAD TRUSTEE Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd NOTES:Holders of the samurai bonds will receive US$9,165.90 for each one million yen bond held to maturity. The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in U.S. dollars.
